source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
3. Click on the pencil located within the bottom right of the inspection section under
    “objectives completed:”
4. Scroll down to “observation"
5. Find an observation that relates to the building you are auditing and will require a
    clarifying note.
6. Click on the pencil in the bottom right of that observation.
7. Type your question in the "Observation Clarifying Note"
    A. If the clarifying note is related to a photo with a grey "not established"
tag, indicate which photo you are referring to in the clarifying note. 
8. Click save.
9. You will be returned to the inspection edit page where you started. If you wish to edit other 
observations, click on other notes and follow the directions. When finished click on the
circle and the X to return to the previous screen.
